glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲) and ideogrammic compound (會意): semantic 人 (“man”) + phonetic 東 (“bag”) – a man carrying a bag. A glyph 土 (“earth”) was later added to show that the bag-carrying man is standing on the ground. From this composition (𡍺) is the current form. In the modern form, the man on top can be seen as 亻 (however, the upper part of the character is unrelated to 千). See also 以, in which a person is carrying something, 央, in which a person is carrying a pole, and 年, in which a person is carrying the harvest.
senses: [chóng] to stack up; to pile up; to overlay
